The fact I'm even reviewing a GP says it all imo.

I've had a lot of contact with the surgery for various mental and physical sickness over the last few years - and I'm routinely impressed by the compassion and care provided by the team.

The booking system is a pain but isn't that just ever NHS GP service now? And credit where due, the practice does provide routine appointment and follow-ups where on-the-day triage isn't necessarily needed.

I think many people expect miracles from the GP; admittedly not ever appointment has gone well and often that's the nature of healthcare and working with people!

But the key thing that matters is even when I didn't necessarily feel my point was understood - the staff at the practice create a safe and open environment and that makes all the difference when a patient needs a bit more support than it might first appear.
